items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: And, I ran into Louis Armstrong, who was playing trumpet at the Savoy Ballroom in the Carroll Dickerson's band.

ctx.x: His records were hot then. And, I ran into Louis Armstrong, who was playing trumpet at the Savoy Ballroom in the Carroll Dickerson's band. Carroll Dickerson was a fiddle player. And Louis Armstrong was playing in the band with Carroll Dickerson.
